description_en: Modifies the inspection configuration of an instance

parameters.help_en: The client token used to ensure idempotency. It is valid for 24 hours within the lifecycle of the instance configuration. If the same token is used for the same request, the result of the first successful call is returned. If the same token is used for a different request, a conflict error is returned. New requests must still include the current revision
